locale_lang.description: BCP-47 code of the language these messages are written in. Set it to your locale's code (for example fr or pt-BR). Pages use it for their lang attribute and plural rules.

ext_name.description: Extension name in Chrome and the Web Store. A product name; usually not translated.

ext_description.message: Learn languages through the English you already read: contextual words, hover hints and click-to-English.
ext_description.description: Extension description in Chrome and the Web Store.

command_pause.message: Pause or resume Lang Weave on this site

swap_description.description: Screen-reader description of a word shown in the target language: its English gloss, then the click action.

swap_show_language.description: Screen-reader description of a word flipped to English: the click action.

practice_cue_title.description: Tooltip of an English word marked for practice.

practice_cue_label.description: Screen-reader name of an English word marked for practice.

recall_label.description: Screen-reader name of the inline practice panel.

recall_prompt.description: Instruction at the top of the inline practice panel.

recall_dismiss.description: Button that closes the inline practice panel.

recall_cue_unavailable.message: Cue unavailable. Dismiss and try again.
recall_cue_unavailable.description: Inline practice status when it could not start.

recall_reveal.description: Button that shows the answer in the inline practice panel.

rating_known.description: Marks a word as already known instead of rating this recall.

recall_rating_failed.message: Rating was not saved. Try again or dismiss.
recall_rating_failed.description: Inline practice status when saving a rating failed.

recall_answer_failed.message: Answer unavailable. Try again or dismiss.
recall_answer_failed.description: Inline practice status when the answer could not be shown.

status_key_rejected.message: Gemini rejected this key. Paste a new one.
status_key_rejected.description: Model status when Gemini rejects the API key. Fixed copy: never include provider or error text.

status_key_isolation.message: This browser cannot keep the key private. Update Chrome to 140 or newer.
status_key_isolation.description: Model status when the browser cannot isolate the key. Fixed copy: never include provider or error text.

status_local_budget.description: Model status when the local daily call budget is used. Fixed copy: never include provider or error text.

status_daily_quota_later.message: Daily model quota reached. Try again later.
status_daily_quota_later.description: Model status for an exhausted daily quota without a retry time. Fixed copy: never include provider or error text.

status_daily_quota_retry.message: Daily model quota reached. Retry after $TIME$.
status_daily_quota_retry.description: Model status for an exhausted daily quota with a retry time. Fixed copy: never include provider or error text.

status_rate_limit_later.message: Model rate limit reached. Try again shortly.
status_rate_limit_later.description: Model status for a rate limit without a retry time. Fixed copy: never include provider or error text.

status_rate_limit_retry.message: Model rate limit reached. Retry after $TIME$.
status_rate_limit_retry.description: Model status for a rate limit with a retry time. Fixed copy: never include provider or error text.

status_overloaded_later.message: Model service is busy. Try again shortly.
status_overloaded_later.description: Model status when the service is overloaded, without a retry time. Fixed copy: never include provider or error text.

status_overloaded_retry.message: Model service is busy. Retry after $TIME$.
status_overloaded_retry.description: Model status when the service is overloaded, with a retry time. Fixed copy: never include provider or error text.

status_storage_failed.message: Local reading storage failed. Try again.
status_storage_failed.description: Model status when saving reading data failed. Fixed copy: never include provider or error text.

status_request_failed.message: Model request failed. Try again later.
status_request_failed.description: Model status for any other failed request. Fixed copy: never include provider or error text.

badge_new_text.description: Toolbar badge text when an update is waiting. At most 4 characters.

badge_new.message: New Lang Weave version available; reload the extension
badge_new.description: Badge tooltip when an update is waiting. Toolbar badge tooltip; fixed copy.

badge_working.description: Badge tooltip when the extension is active on this page. Toolbar badge tooltip; fixed copy.

badge_needs_setup.message: Finish setup in the welcome page
badge_needs_setup.description: Badge tooltip before setup is finished. Toolbar badge tooltip; fixed copy.

badge_needs_key.description: Badge tooltip when no API key is saved. Toolbar badge tooltip; fixed copy.

badge_key_rejected.message: Gemini rejected this key. Paste a new one.
badge_key_rejected.description: Badge tooltip when Gemini rejects the API key. Toolbar badge tooltip; fixed copy.

badge_needs_site.description: Badge tooltip when this site has not been allowed. Toolbar badge tooltip; fixed copy.

badge_paused.message: Lang Weave is paused; click to turn it on
badge_paused.description: Badge tooltip when the extension is paused. Toolbar badge tooltip; fixed copy.

badge_sensitive.message: Off on sensitive sites; click to turn on here
badge_sensitive.description: Badge tooltip on a sensitive site. Toolbar badge tooltip; fixed copy.

badge_site_off.message: Off on this site; click to turn it on
badge_site_off.description: Badge tooltip when this site is turned off. Toolbar badge tooltip; fixed copy.

badge_unavailable.message: Open Lang Weave to check this page
badge_unavailable.description: Badge tooltip when the page state is unknown. Toolbar badge tooltip; fixed copy.

badge_unsupported.message: Open a website to use Lang Weave
badge_unsupported.description: Badge tooltip on browser pages. Toolbar badge tooltip; fixed copy.

badge_local_budget.message: Daily model-call budget reached; review still works
badge_local_budget.description: Badge tooltip when the local daily call budget is used. Toolbar badge tooltip; fixed copy.

badge_model_error.message: Model request failed; review still works
badge_model_error.description: Badge tooltip after a failed model request. Toolbar badge tooltip; fixed copy.

badge_paused_until.description: Badge tooltip during a model cooldown with a known end. Toolbar badge tooltip; fixed copy.

badge_reading_paused.message: Reading is paused; review still works
badge_reading_paused.description: Badge tooltip during a model cooldown without a known end. Toolbar badge tooltip; fixed copy.

popup_title.description: Toolbar popup: window title and heading. A product name; usually not translated.

popup_switch_on.description: Toolbar popup: visible label next to the master on/off switch when Lang Weave is on.

popup_switch_off.description: Toolbar popup: visible label next to the master on/off switch when Lang Weave is off.

popup_enabled_label.description: Toolbar popup: screen-reader name of the master on/off switch.

popup_this_site.description: Toolbar popup: initial label of the per-site switch before the page is known.

popup_not_a_website.message: This page is not a website
popup_not_a_website.description: Toolbar popup: label of the disabled per-site switch on a browser-internal page.

popup_turn_on_site.description: Toolbar popup: label of the per-site switch when the site is not yet on.

popup_on_for_site.description: Toolbar popup: label of the per-site switch when the site is on. Also its screen-reader name.

popup_practice.description: Toolbar popup: initial text of the main button, shown until the progress summary decides its label.

popup_budget_warning.message: The saved introduction date ($DATE$) is over seven days ahead of your local date. New introductions stay paused. Reset only today's introduction budget? Your reviews and progress stay saved.
popup_budget_warning.description: Toolbar popup: warning when the stored daily-introduction date is far in the future; asks whether to reset only the daily budget. $DATE$ is a calendar day.

popup_budget_reset.description: Toolbar popup: button that confirms resetting the daily new-word budget.

popup_budget_keep.description: Toolbar popup: button that dismisses the budget reset prompt and leaves new words paused.

popup_more.description: Toolbar popup: screen-reader name of the navigation with the Settings, My words and Help links.

popup_settings.description: Toolbar popup: link that opens the settings page.

popup_my_words.description: Toolbar popup: link that opens the page listing the learner's words.

popup_help.description: Toolbar popup: link to the online help.

popup_state_off.description: Toolbar popup: status line when Lang Weave is switched off.

popup_state_needs_setup.message: Finish setup in the welcome page
popup_state_needs_setup.description: Toolbar popup: status line before the first-run choices are made.

popup_state_needs_key.message: Add a Gemini key to start
popup_state_needs_key.description: Toolbar popup: status line when no Gemini API key is saved.

popup_state_site_off.description: Toolbar popup: status line when the current site is off or never allowed (for example webmail or banking).

popup_state_needs_site.description: Toolbar popup: status line when Chrome has not yet granted access to the current site.

popup_state_on.description: Toolbar popup: status line when everything is working.

popup_error_generic.description: Toolbar popup: error shown when an action fails without a specific reason.

popup_error_reload.message: Reload this page to start. Chrome blocks extensions on some pages.
popup_error_reload.description: Toolbar popup: error shown when Lang Weave cannot start on the open tab.

popup_error_budget_changed.message: Budget changed. Refresh and try again.
popup_error_budget_changed.description: Toolbar popup: error shown when the introduction budget changed before the reset was applied.

options_intro.message: Choose how Lang Weave learns from the sites you allow.
options_intro.description: Settings page: introduction under the main heading.

options_learning_heading.description: Settings page: heading of the Learning section.

options_language_label.description: Settings page: label of the learning-language selector.

options_language_hint.message: Spanish is bundled; generated languages are experimental and stored locally.
options_language_hint.description: Settings page: hint under the language selector.

options_remove_language.message: Remove this generated language and its local progress
options_remove_language.description: Settings page: button that deletes a generated language pack and its progress.

options_add_language_summary.description: Settings page: collapsible heading for adding a generated language.

options_add_language_intro.message: Generated vocabulary is experimental. Add your Gemini key below first. Use a language code such as fr or ja.
options_add_language_intro.description: Settings page: explanation inside the add-a-language section. fr and ja are example language codes.

options_new_language_label.description: Settings page: label of the field for a new language code.

options_new_language_hint.message: A new pack is generated with Gemini and stored only in this extension.
options_new_language_hint.description: Settings page: hint under the new language code field.

options_generate_vocabulary.description: Settings page: button that generates vocabulary for the new language.

options_level_info.description: Settings page: line showing the reading level in effect. $LEVEL$ is the level, for example L1.

options_level_label.description: Settings page: label of the reading-level selector.

options_level_default.description: Settings page: reading-level choice that follows the default (Beginner).

options_level_1.description: Settings page: reading-level choice for level 1.

options_level_2.description: Settings page: reading-level choice for level 2.

options_level_hint.message: Choose which vocabulary levels may appear; these are not CEFR grades.
options_level_hint.description: Settings page: hint under the reading-level selector. CEFR is the Common European Framework of Reference for languages.

options_gradual_label.description: Settings page: label of the gradual-learning checkbox.

options_gradual_hint.message: Introduce only words that fit what you read, with due words first.
options_gradual_hint.description: Settings page: hint under the gradual-learning checkbox.

options_new_words_label.description: Settings page: label of the new-words-per-day selector.

options_new_words_hint.message: The daily introduction budget applies when gradual learning is on.
options_new_words_hint.description: Settings page: hint under the new-words-per-day selector.

options_density_label.description: Settings page: label of the translation-density selector.

options_density_light.description: Settings page: translation-density choice with the fewest woven words.

options_density_normal.description: Settings page: translation-density choice with a normal number of woven words.

options_density_heavy.description: Settings page: translation-density choice with the most woven words.

options_density_hint.message: Control how many eligible words are woven into a passage.
options_density_hint.description: Settings page: hint under the translation-density selector.

options_recall_label.description: Settings page: label of the inline-recall checkbox.

options_recall_hint.message: Activate a marked word to reveal and rate recall within the page.
options_recall_hint.description: Settings page: hint under the inline-recall checkbox.

options_vocabulary_info.message: Eligible vocabulary: $WORDS$ (not words learned). Recall reviews due: $DUE$.
options_vocabulary_info.description: Settings page: counts of eligible vocabulary and recall reviews due. $WORDS$ is a phrase such as "30 Spanish words"; $DUE$ is a number.

options_reading_help.message: While reading, hover for meaning; click a woven word to flip it or open inline recall when available.
options_reading_help.description: Settings page: reminder of how to use woven words while reading.

options_sites_heading.description: Settings page: heading of the Sites and privacy section.

options_age_notice.message: The Gemini API requires users to be 18 or older.
options_age_notice.description: Settings page: notice about the Gemini API age requirement.

options_welcome_link.message: $LINK$ before testing a key or generating vocabulary.
options_welcome_link.description: Settings page: sentence shown before the first-run choices are made. $LINK$ is the link to the welcome page, whose text is its own message.

options_welcome_link_text.description: Settings page: text of the link to the welcome page. Starts a sentence.

options_new_sites_label.description: Settings page: label of the selector for sites not listed as exceptions.

options_new_sites_on.description: Settings page: choice meaning new sites start on.

options_new_sites_off.description: Settings page: choice meaning only sites the learner turns on are active.

options_new_sites_hint.message: Choose whether new permitted sites start on; sensitive sites still start off.
options_new_sites_hint.description: Settings page: hint under the other-sites selector.

options_grant_sites.description: Settings page: button that asks Chrome for access to all websites.

options_exceptions_heading.description: Settings page: heading above the list of per-site exceptions.

options_privacy_note.message: Sites where it's on send readable page text to Gemini with your key. With a free key, Google may use it to improve its products; a paid key avoids that. Links and inline code go with their sentence but are never changed; code blocks, forms and editable text are skipped.
options_privacy_note.description: Settings page: explanation of what is sent to Gemini and what is skipped.

options_gemini_heading.description: Settings page: heading of the Gemini section. Gemini is a product name.

options_model_label.description: Settings page: label of the Gemini model selector.

options_model_hint.message: Choose the Gemini model that selects words in context.
options_model_hint.description: Settings page: hint under the model selector.

options_key_label.description: Settings page: label of the API key field.

options_key_hint.message: $LINK$: open AI Studio, create a key, then paste it here.
options_key_hint.description: Settings page: hint under the key field. $LINK$ is a link to Google AI Studio, whose text is its own message.

options_key_hint_link.description: Settings page: text of the link to Google AI Studio. Starts a sentence that continues with a colon.

options_billing_note.message: Use a billed key: Google may use free-tier text to improve products, and EEA, UK and Swiss users need paid services.
options_billing_note.description: Settings page: advice to use a billed key. EEA is the European Economic Area.

options_call_cap_note.message: Lang Weave allows up to 1,000 model calls per local day. This is a request cap, not a spending limit; provider quotas and pricing still apply.
options_call_cap_note.description: Settings page: explanation of the daily request cap.

options_save_key.description: Settings page: button that saves the pasted key.

options_test_key.description: Settings page: button that tests the saved key.

options_remove_key.description: Settings page: button that deletes the saved key.

options_data_heading.description: Settings page: heading of the Your data section.

options_backup_info.message: $LINK$ exports or restores learning progress without keys or site grants.
options_backup_info.description: Settings page: description of the backup page. $LINK$ is its link, whose text is its own message.

options_backup_link.description: Settings page: text of the link to the backup page. Starts a sentence.

options_words_info.message: $LINK$ shows every word's stage and next review, lets you practise or reset one, and answers "is this working?".
options_words_info.description: Settings page: description of the My words page. $LINK$ is its link, whose text is its own message.

options_words_link.description: Settings page: text of the link to the My words page. Starts a sentence.

options_personal_info.message: $LINK$ lets you find, archive and export your own words.
options_personal_info.description: Settings page: description of the personal entries page. $LINK$ is its link, whose text is its own message.

options_personal_link.description: Settings page: text of the link to the personal entries page. Starts a sentence.

options_clear_cache.description: Settings page: button that clears the cache of replacement choices.

options_clear_cache_note.message: Forget cached replacement choices so the next eligible reading request asks Gemini again. Learning progress stays saved.
options_clear_cache_note.description: Settings page: explanation under the clear-cache button.

options_about_heading.description: Settings page: heading of the About section.

options_version_line.description: Settings page: version and legal links. $VERSION$ is a version number; $LICENSE$ and $NOTICE$ are links whose text is their own messages.

options_license_link.description: Settings page: text of the link to the license. AGPL-3.0-or-later is a license identifier.

options_notice_link.description: Settings page: text of the link to the NOTICE file with upstream credits.

options_credits.message: Based on Jackie Oliver's French Weave, with attribution and the inherited MIT license retained. The Spanish starter vocabulary is not a certified curriculum or native-speaker review. Generated packs are experimental; contextual or grammatical mistakes remain possible.
options_credits.description: Settings page: attribution and limitations of the bundled vocabulary.

options_update_notice.message: Update $VERSION$ didn't load by itself: click the reload arrow on Lang Weave in the extensions page.
options_update_notice.description: Settings page: shown when a new version downloaded but did not load by itself. $VERSION$ is the new version number.

options_open_extensions.description: Settings page: button that opens Chrome's extensions page.

options_consent_chosen.message: Your site policy has been chosen. You can change it below.
options_consent_chosen.description: Settings page: note shown after the first-run site policy was chosen.

options_consent_pending.message: Choose a site policy on the welcome page before Lang Weave sends anything to Gemini.
options_consent_pending.description: Settings page: note shown before the first-run site policy is chosen.

options_access_all.message: On for every site except the ones you turn off. Webmail, messaging, AI chat, banking, health, government and local addresses start off. Reload pages already open to start there.
options_access_all.description: Settings page: access note when all websites are allowed.

options_access_needs_ok.message: Chrome needs your OK before it can run on other sites.
options_access_needs_ok.description: Settings page: access note when sites are on by default but Chrome has not granted access to all of them.

options_access_off.message: Off on sites until you turn them on here.
options_access_off.description: Settings page: access note when new sites start off.

options_level_value.description: Settings page: the reading level in effect, written as a short label (L for level).

options_language_experimental.description: Settings page: language selector entry for a generated language. $NAME$ is the language name.

options_word_count.description: Settings page: how many eligible words the learning language has. $COUNT$ is a number and $LANGUAGE$ is the language name.

options_key_saved_placeholder.description: Settings page: placeholder of the key field when a key is already saved.

options_site_on.description: Settings page: a site exception that is on. $HOST$ is a website name.

options_site_off.description: Settings page: a site exception that is off. $HOST$ is a website name.

options_site_reset.description: Settings page: button that removes one site exception.

options_no_exceptions.description: Settings page: shown when there are no site exceptions.

options_error_generic.description: Settings page: error shown when an action fails without a specific reason.

options_generating.description: Settings page: progress message while a generated language is being created.

options_key_paste_first.description: Settings page: key feedback when Save key is used with an empty field.

options_key_saved.description: Settings page: key feedback after the key was saved.

options_key_testing.description: Settings page: key feedback while the key is being tested.

options_key_works.description: Settings page: key feedback after a successful test.

options_key_add_first.description: Settings page: key feedback when testing without a saved key.

options_key_changed.message: Key or settings changed. Test again.
options_key_changed.description: Settings page: key feedback when the key or settings changed during the test.

options_key_model_failed.message: Model request failed. Try again later.
options_key_model_failed.description: Settings page: key feedback when the test failed for an unclassified reason.

options_key_removed.description: Settings page: key feedback after the key was removed.

options_cleared.description: Settings page: result of Clear cache. $COUNT$ is the number of cached entries removed.

options_error_refresh.description: Settings page: error shown when the page cannot reload its state.
